title.es-AR: Cronología maestra de la Guerra de Malvinas
title.en-GB: Master chronology of the Falklands War

editorialPolicy: The historical outcome is immutable and must never be overwritten by a player result.
An event is not promoted to a mission without unit, location and source review.
Institutional narratives are attributed to their source; the game does not speak with a sovereignty verdict.
Contested claims remain visible as contested and are not silently resolved by the simulation.
The daily index is complete for the date range; detailed event coverage is intentionally incremental.

units: Argentine amphibious and special operations forces

summary.es-AR: Fuerzas argentinas toman el control de las instalaciones principales de Puerto Argentino y el destacamento de Royal Marines se rinde.
summary.en-GB: Argentine forces take control of the main installations at Port Stanley and the Royal Marine detachment surrenders.

events.historicalOutcome: Argentine control of the Falkland Islands is established.

verification.notes: Exact order of sub-actions and unit-level order of battle still requires archival review.

summary.es-AR: Un C-130 aterriza en el aeródromo y los primeros IA-58 Pucará llegan a las islas durante la operación de asalto y sostenimiento.
summary.en-GB: A C-130 lands at the airfield and the first IA-58 Pucará aircraft arrive during the assault and sustainment operation.

events.historicalOutcome: The airfield becomes the initial Argentine air and logistics link with the mainland.

verification.notes: Aircraft serials are preserved from the FAA account; mission gameplay should use role and silhouette, not photographic reproduction.

units: Royal Marines detachment from HMS Endurance

summary.es-AR: Fuerzas argentinas ocupan Grytviken después de la resistencia del pequeño destacamento de Royal Marines.
summary.en-GB: Argentine forces occupy Grytviken after resistance by the small Royal Marine detachment.

events.historicalOutcome: South Georgia is under Argentine control until the British operation later in April.

verification.notes: This is a separate island operation and should not be conflated with the East Falkland campaign map.

summary.es-AR: El Reino Unido reúne y hace zarpar una fuerza de tareas para recuperar las islas, con el componente de portaaviones, anfibio y submarino ya en movimiento.
summary.en-GB: The United Kingdom assembles and sails a task force to retake the islands, including carrier, amphibious and submarine elements.

events.historicalOutcome: Operation Corporate begins as a long-distance naval and logistical campaign.

verification.notes: The event is strategic context rather than a single tactical mission.

summary.es-AR: La Fuerza Aérea Argentina crea la Fuerza Aérea Sur para organizar sus operaciones en el teatro del Atlántico Sur.
summary.en-GB: The Argentine Air Force creates Fuerza Aérea Sur to organise its operations in the South Atlantic theatre.

events.historicalOutcome: Air operations are placed under a dedicated theatre command.

verification.notes: Command relationships and subordinate units require a dedicated order-of-battle pass.

summary.es-AR: Se crea la Base Aérea Militar Cóndor como parte del despliegue aéreo argentino en las islas.
summary.en-GB: BAM Cóndor is established as part of the Argentine air deployment on the islands.

events.historicalOutcome: Darwin and Goose Green become an important Argentine aviation and logistics node.

verification.notes: The exact initial establishment layout is pending terrain and archival mapping.

units: British special forces and Royal Marines

summary.es-AR: La operación británica sobre South Georgia culmina con la recuperación de Grytviken; el ARA Santa Fe queda fuera de combate.
summary.en-GB: The British operation on South Georgia culminates in the recapture of Grytviken; ARA Santa Fe is put out of action.

events.historicalOutcome: South Georgia is recovered by British forces on 26 April.

verification.notes: The exact sequence of helicopter losses, submarine damage and surrender terms requires mission-level archival treatment.

summary.es-AR: El Reino Unido define una zona de exclusión marítima total de 200 millas alrededor de las islas.
summary.en-GB: The United Kingdom defines a 200-mile maritime total exclusion zone around the islands.

events.historicalOutcome: The zone becomes part of the operational and diplomatic context of the naval war.

verification.notes: The event must be represented as a rule-of-engagement context, not as a claim that every action occurred inside the zone.

summary.es-AR: Comienzan los bombardeos británicos sobre aeródromos y posiciones argentinas; la Fuerza Aérea Argentina entra en combate y se inicia la fase abierta de la guerra aérea y naval.
summary.en-GB: British strikes begin against airfields and Argentine positions; the Argentine Air Force enters combat and the open air and naval phase begins.

events.historicalOutcome: The air war becomes an ongoing contest over access to the islands and the fleet.

verification.notes: Aircraft-loss and sortie counts are intentionally excluded until reconciled against the FAA archive and British operational records.

locations: South Atlantic, south of the exclusion zone

summary.es-AR: El submarino HMS Conqueror torpedea y hunde al crucero ARA General Belgrano; 323 tripulantes mueren y 770 sobreviven al hundimiento.
summary.en-GB: HMS Conqueror torpedoes and sinks the cruiser ARA General Belgrano; 323 crew members die and 770 survive the sinking.

events.historicalOutcome: The loss of the Belgrano becomes a central naval and political turning point in the conflict.

verification.notes: The location outside the British exclusion zone and the legal/operational interpretation must remain attributed to sources rather than narrated as a game verdict.

summary.es-AR: El aviso ARA Alférez Sobral es atacado y las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate de sus tripulantes continúan durante los días siguientes.
summary.en-GB: The aviso ARA Alférez Sobral is attacked and search-and-rescue operations for its crew continue over the following days.

events.historicalOutcome: The damaged vessel reaches the Argentine mainland after rescue operations.

verification.notes: The event is included in the master index; vessel damage and casualty details need a second archival pass.

locations: South Atlantic, west of the Falklands

summary.es-AR: Dos Super Étendard, guiados por la exploración del Neptune y reabastecidos por un KC-130, atacan al HMS Sheffield con misiles Exocet; el buque se hunde días después.
summary.en-GB: Two Super Étendards, supported by Neptune reconnaissance and a KC-130 tanker, attack HMS Sheffield with Exocet missiles; the ship sinks days later.

events.historicalOutcome: HMS Sheffield is lost after the missile attack and subsequent fire.

verification.notes: Exact missile impact and sinking sequence should be represented with source attribution in the archive entry.

summary.es-AR: El transporte ARA Isla de los Estados es atacado y hundido en el canal de San Carlos.
summary.en-GB: The transport ARA Isla de los Estados is attacked and sunk in Falkland Sound.

events.historicalOutcome: The transport is lost during the approach to the landing area.

verification.notes: Crew and cargo details remain outside this first pass.

summary.es-AR: La fuerza anfibia británica desembarca en San Carlos; los ataques aéreos argentinos convierten el estrecho y la bahía en el principal foco naval de la campaña.
summary.en-GB: The British amphibious force lands at San Carlos; Argentine air attacks turn the sound and bay into the campaign's main naval focus.

events.historicalOutcome: A British bridgehead is established on East Falkland and the land campaign begins.

verification.notes: The event is a campaign milestone; separate missions should handle the individual ship attacks.

summary.es-AR: El HMS Antelope resulta alcanzado durante los ataques aéreos; una bomba sin explotar detona durante el intento de desactivación y el buque se parte y se hunde.
summary.en-GB: HMS Antelope is hit during air attacks; an unexploded bomb detonates during an attempt to disarm it and the ship breaks apart and sinks.

events.historicalOutcome: HMS Antelope is lost in San Carlos Water.

verification.notes: The ship-loss sequence is suitable for an archive entry; it should not be gamified as a guaranteed event.

summary.es-AR: Una sección de A-4B ataca al HMS Coventry, que navega junto al HMS Broadsword, y el destructor británico se hunde.
summary.en-GB: A section of A-4B aircraft attacks HMS Coventry, sailing with HMS Broadsword, and the British destroyer is sunk.

events.historicalOutcome: HMS Coventry is lost during the air battle around the San Carlos bridgehead.

verification.notes: The FAA archive collection is the primary Argentine archive catalogue; a document-level record is still needed before mission production.

summary.es-AR: Un ataque argentino daña gravemente al portacontenedores Atlantic Conveyor y se pierden helicópteros y material logístico esenciales para la campaña británica.
summary.en-GB: An Argentine attack badly damages the container ship Atlantic Conveyor, destroying helicopters and logistical material vital to the British campaign.

events.historicalOutcome: British troop movement becomes more dependent on ships and marching after the loss of the helicopters.

verification.notes: Exact inventory of lost equipment will be added from the official history and naval records.

summary.es-AR: El 2 PARA británico ataca las posiciones argentinas en Darwin y Pradera del Ganso; tras combates prolongados, las fuerzas argentinas de la guarnición se rinden.
summary.en-GB: 2 PARA attacks Argentine positions at Darwin and Goose Green; after prolonged fighting, the Argentine garrison surrenders.

events.historicalOutcome: British forces secure Darwin and Goose Green, creating a key step toward Stanley.

verification.notes: This is the recommended first ground mission. Exact initial dispositions, ammunition and weather belong in a separate scenario file.

locations: South Atlantic east of the Falklands

summary.es-AR: La Argentina sostiene que un ataque combinado alcanzó al portaviones HMS Invincible; la versión británica no reconoce el hundimiento ni un daño decisivo al buque.
summary.en-GB: Argentina maintains that a combined attack hit HMS Invincible; the British account does not accept that the carrier was sunk or decisively damaged.

events.historicalOutcome: The historical record is contested; the game must present the disagreement rather than canonise one claim.

verification.notes: Do not make this a required campaign fact until British and Argentine archival accounts are compared at document level.

summary.es-AR: La fuerza terrestre británica consolida la cabeza de playa y se aproxima a Puerto Argentino, preparando los ataques contra las alturas que protegen la capital.
summary.en-GB: British land forces consolidate the bridgehead and move toward Stanley, preparing attacks on the heights protecting the capital.

events.historicalOutcome: The operational focus shifts from the San Carlos bridgehead to the defensive ring around Stanley.

verification.notes: This interval needs a separate daily land-movement pass before it becomes a playable scenario.

summary.es-AR: Ataques de A-4 argentinos alcanzan buques británicos en Fitzroy/Bluff Cove durante el traslado de tropas.
summary.en-GB: Argentine A-4 attacks strike British ships at Fitzroy/Bluff Cove during the transfer of troops.

events.historicalOutcome: The attack causes severe British losses and delays the final advance on Stanley.

verification.notes: Ship-by-ship casualty and unit details remain to be reconciled from Argentine and British records.

summary.es-AR: Comienzan los ataques británicos contra las alturas occidentales y norteñas del dispositivo de Puerto Argentino; Longdon, Dos Hermanas y Harriet son escenarios de combates intensos.
summary.en-GB: British attacks begin against the western and northern heights of the Stanley defensive system; Longdon, Two Sisters and Harriet see intense fighting.

events.historicalOutcome: British forces take key heights and open the final approach to Stanley.

verification.notes: Terrain and command relationships require a map-and-testimony pass before balancing the mission.

summary.es-AR: El HMS Glamorgan es alcanzado por un misil Exocet lanzado desde una posición costera argentina.
summary.en-GB: HMS Glamorgan is hit by an Exocet missile launched from an Argentine coastal position.

events.historicalOutcome: The ship is damaged but remains part of the campaign's naval gunfire support.

verification.notes: The launcher identity and firing sequence need document-level confirmation before modelling.

summary.es-AR: Las fuerzas británicas atacan Monte Tumbledown y las posiciones conectadas con Sapper Hill y Pony's Pass, defendidas por unidades argentinas, incluido el BIM 5.
summary.en-GB: British forces attack Mount Tumbledown and positions linked to Sapper Hill and Pony's Pass, defended by Argentine units including BIM 5.

events.historicalOutcome: The defensive heights around Stanley are lost before the surrender.

verification.notes: Combat chronology spans nights and should be broken into mission phases rather than one scripted event.

units: Escuadrón de Exploración de Caballería Blindado 10

summary.es-AR: El 2 PARA, apoyado por blindados y artillería, ataca Wireless Ridge; el Regimiento de Infantería 7 y unidades argentinas de apoyo combaten durante la noche.
summary.en-GB: 2 PARA, supported by armoured vehicles and artillery, attacks Wireless Ridge; RI 7 and Argentine support units fight through the night.

events.historicalOutcome: Wireless Ridge is in British hands by the morning of 14 June.

verification.notes: The Argentine official account provides detailed timings; the British order of battle still needs a document-level cross-check.

units: Argentine garrison under General Mario Menéndez
British land forces under Major General Jeremy Moore

summary.es-AR: El comandante argentino en las islas firma la rendición ante el comandante británico; cesan las operaciones principales en las islas.
summary.en-GB: The Argentine commander on the islands signs the surrender to the British commander; major operations on the islands cease.

events.historicalOutcome: The Argentine forces in the Falkland Islands surrender on 14 June 1982.

verification.notes: The surrender instrument is available through the Falkland Islands National Archives and should become the canonical campaign-end record.
